name: WhatsApp Review
description: Read-only WhatsApp Web ingestion and local indexed triage with an approved-chat allowlist.

commands.name: /whatsapp
commands.description: Surface approved WhatsApp chats into Signal without starting a Codex turn.

requiredConfig.name: SABLE_WHATSAPP_APPROVED_CHATS_PATH
requiredConfig.description: Path to the approved WhatsApp chats JSON allowlist.

requiredConfig.name: SABLE_WHATSAPP_SESSION_PATH
requiredConfig.description: Legacy alias for the private local WhatsApp state directory.

requiredConfig.name: SABLE_WHATSAPP_STATE_DIR
requiredConfig.description: Path to the private browser profile, SQLite index, and diagnostic artifacts.

privateDataPolicy: Store browser credentials, approved-chat configuration, indexed contact/chat/message data, attachments metadata, exports, and diagnostics only under private instance state; never commit them.
